statements.t: The 2027 outlook assumes continued deployment of the Company’s existing aviation fleet, incremental contributions from aviation investments and continued operating improvement across the Company’s portfolio and does not assume material aviation asset sales.
With an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 15% through the first nine months, we are raising our full-year 2026 outlook for the third time this year.
We now expect Adjusted EBITDA margins in the mid-teens, roughly a year ahead of the plan we laid out in March, and we are reaffirming our outlook for revenue growth of greater than 90%.

As we look ahead to 2027, we currently expect Adjusted EBITDA to increase by more than 40% compared with full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA, driven primarily by the growing contribution from our aviation leasing platform and continued focus on operating execution and margin improvement.”

The Company also provides fiber optic services to utility customers; natural sand proppant for hydraulic fracturing; workforce accommodations for projects in remote locations; and directional drilling services.

• our ability to execute our business strategy, successfully integrate acquired businesses, realize anticipated acquisition benefits, grow existing operations and identify additional growth opportunities;
• our ability to successfully deploy capital into aviation assets, achieve expected utilization levels and realize anticipated returns on aviation-related investments;
Management expects utilization and operating performance to improve as these acquisitions are further integrated and customer activity expands.
